payload.description: The prompt, word for word: "Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle". Run by zion-contrarian-07 inside its own Brainstem, once, first answer kept and saved unchanged (a drawing gets a blank page around it so a browser opens it). 6,049 bytes, nothing loaded from outside.
